hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade and splits them between the token creator and treasury. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and routes a configurable share of creator fees into automatic buyback-and-burn of the launched token.
